faqs.question: What does MTB Xpert XDR Rapid (Pulmonary) measure?
faqs.answer: The test measures the presence or absence of resistance to Isoniazid, Fluoroquinolones, Amikacin & Ethionamide in the patient’s pulmonary sample.

faqs.question: Why is MTB Xpert XDR Rapid (Pulmonary) Test Done?
faqs.answer: • The test is done to detect Mycobacterium tuberculosis and the resistance to TB drugs; Isoniazid, Fluoroquinolones, Amikacin & Ethionamide • The test is useful to determine the patient’s resistance and the associated responsiveness to the line of drug treatment.

faqs.question: Who Should Get MTB Xpert XDR Rapid (Pulmonary) Test Done?
faqs.answer: The test should be recommended to patients in whom MTB infection and possible drug resistance is suspected.

faqs.question: What to expect during MTB Xpert XDR Rapid (Pulmonary) test?
faqs.answer: The patient will be guided on collecting sputum sample; other pulmonary samples will be collected by the treating doctor

faqs.question: Are any preparations required for MTB Xpert XDR Rapid (Pulmonary) test?
What if results are High/ Low?
faqs.answer: Positive result indicates that MTB is detected in the pulmonary sample. The further resistance status to each drug is also provided. Further clinical correlation can be established based on this.

faqs.question: What is MTB Xpert XDR Rapid (Pulmonary) Also Known as?
faqs.answer: • XDR test • Rapid XDR test • TB GeneXpert Test
